Multi-column textbox row annotation for ComplexHeatmap

Source: R/anno_multicol_textbox.R
dot-anno_multicol_textbox.Rd

Row annotation that displays multiple enrichment categories side by side in a single annotation block. Follows the same interface convention as ComplexHeatmap:::anno_textbox. Column headers are drawn above the first module via decorate_annotation-style header placement.

Usage

.anno_multicol_textbox(
  align_to,
  text,
  background_gp = grid::gpar(fill = "#DDDDDD", col = "#AAAAAA"),
  which = c("row", "column"),
  by = "anno_link",
  side = c("right", "left"),
  ...
)

Arguments

align_to

A vector of group labels, a list of indices, or a named list mapping groups to row indices (same as ComplexHeatmap::anno_textbox).

text

A list of per-module enrichment terms, where each element is a named list of category term data.frames (columns text, col, fontsize). Output from .reformat_cat_terms.

background_gp

Background graphical parameters for the annotation block (fill, col, lty, lwd).

which

"row" (only row annotations are supported).

by

Link type: "anno_link" (default, aligns to heatmap rows) or "anno_block".

side

"right" (default) or "left".

...

Additional arguments passed to .multicol_textbox_grob. Notable options: show_headers (logical), header_gp (gpar for header text), header_offset (unit offset above annotation).

Value

A ComplexHeatmap annotation object (from anno_link or anno_block).
